description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of the GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES environment variable and its interaction with git commands, particularly involving directory traversal and prefix calculations.

methods.name: test_prefix
methods.description: A helper function that sets expectations and verifies the output of 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' given specific GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES settings.

methods.name: test_fail
methods.description: A helper function that tests for expected command failure when GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES are set to certain values.
